title: LearnAlign: Data Selection for LLM Reinforcement Learning with Improved Gradient Alignment
authors_zh: Shipeng Li、Zhiqin Yang、Shikun Li、Xiaobo Xia、Hengyu Liu、Xinghua Zhang、Gaode Chen、Dong Fang、Ying Tai、Zhe Peng
paper_type_zh: Policy-relative RLVR 数据选择与计算效率研究
best_for_zh: 研究 RLVR prompt selection、gradient alignment、选择谱系与计算归因的读者
one_line: LearnAlign ranks prompts for one warmed-up RLVR policy by combining p(1-p) learnability with average cosine alignment among projected GRPO gradients, then trains on the top-N subset; no selected subset or implementation is released.
LearnAlign 用 p(1-p) learnability 与投影 GRPO gradient 的平均余弦对齐，为一个 warmup 后 RLVR policy 排序并选择 top-N prompts；尚未发布选后子集或实现。
why: For data construction and open releases, it turns prompt selection into a checkpoint-relative data stage whose rollouts, verifier decisions, gradients, projection, ranking, and run bindings must be preserved for audit.
inclusion_reason: LearnAlign provides a policy-aware recipe for constructing smaller RLVR prompt subsets from rollout success and projected gradient alignment while making selection compute and score lineage central audit objects.

title: Problem
问题
html:
LearnAlign appears in Findings of ACL 2026, while arXiv:2506.11480 preserves its June 2025 submission history and explains the entry ID. The paper addresses a construction problem inside reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards: a large prompt pool contains tasks that the current policy almost always or almost never solves, and uniform RLVR spends generation and update compute without asking which prompts are useful for that exact policy.

The selected object is not merely a question-answer pair. Reproducible selection would bind an upstream prompt ID and gold answer to a warmup decision, policy checkpoint, eight generated rollouts, binary correctness judgments, success rate p, learnability p(1-p), a projected per-prompt GRPO gradient, pairwise alignment scores, a row-average score, rank, and top-N decision.

That object is policy-relative. A new checkpoint, warmup set, candidate pool, parser, projection, or random seed can change the ranking. LearnAlign therefore belongs to the Data Construction and Open Release track as a selection recipe and audit case, not as a model-independent quality label or a released reasoning corpus.

LearnAlign 正式发表于 Findings of ACL 2026；arXiv:2506.11480 保留了 2025 年 6 月的首次提交历史，也解释了 entry ID 中的年份。论文处理 reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards 内部的数据构造问题：大型 prompt pool 中既有当前 policy 几乎总能答对的题，也有它几乎从不答对的题；uniform RLVR 会持续消耗生成与更新计算，却没有判断哪些 prompts 对这个精确 policy 有用。

选择对象不只是 question-answer pair。若要复现，应把上游 prompt ID 与 gold answer 绑定到 warmup 决策、policy checkpoint、8 条生成 rollouts、二元正确性判定、成功率 p、learnability p(1-p)、每题投影后的 GRPO gradient、两两 alignment scores、行平均分、排名和 top-N 决策。

这一对象依赖 policy。更换 checkpoint、warmup set、candidate pool、parser、projection 或 random seed 都可能改变排序。因此 LearnAlign 在 Data Construction and Open Release track 中应被视为选择 recipe 与审计案例，而不是与模型无关的质量标签或已发布的 reasoning corpus。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
For prompt i, eight rollouts from the warmed-up policy produce a binary success rate p_i. Learnability is V_i=p_i(1-p_i): it is zero when all rollouts fail or succeed and reaches its maximum at p=0.5. LearnAlign normalizes the prompt's GRPO gradient direction, multiplies it by V_i, and applies a random projection to obtain a tractable vector.

The pairwise score S_ij is V_i V_j times cosine similarity between the two projected gradients. LearnAlign constructs the n-by-n score matrix, includes each prompt's self-pair, averages every row, sorts those means, and selects the top N. The intended interpretation is that p(1-p) measures current learning potential while gradient alignment measures representativeness under the RLVR update objective.

The feedback contract remains sparse binary final-answer correctness against ground truth; no intermediate reasoning is checked. The paper's theoretical appendix derives proportionality between policy-gradient magnitude and p(1-p) only under a simplified one-correct-action, one-incorrect-action setting. The metric is therefore a policy-conditioned selection signal, not a general proof of prompt quality.

对 prompt i，warmup 后 policy 的 8 条 rollouts 给出二元成功率 p_i。Learnability 定义为 V_i=p_i(1-p_i)：全部失败或全部成功时为 0，在 p=0.5 时达到最大值。LearnAlign 归一化该 prompt 的 GRPO gradient 方向，乘以 V_i，再通过 random projection 得到可计算的向量。

两两分数 S_ij 等于 V_i V_j 乘以两个投影 gradients 的 cosine similarity。LearnAlign 构造 n×n score matrix，把 prompt 与自身的配对也计入行平均，然后按行平均降序选择 top N。其解释是：p(1-p) 近似当前学习潜力，gradient alignment 近似该样本在 RLVR 更新目标下对整体 pool 的代表性。

反馈合约仍是相对 ground truth 的稀疏二元 final-answer correctness；没有检查中间推理。理论附录只在“一个正确 action、一个错误 action”的简化设置下推导 policy-gradient magnitude 与 p(1-p) 成比例。因此该指标是受 policy 条件约束的 selection signal，而不是 prompt 质量的一般证明。

title: Method
方法
html:
The GSM8K path warms Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on 300 random training prompts, then scores the 7,473-example train pool and selects 100, 500, 1,000, or 2,000 prompts. The DAPO path warms Qwen2.5-3B or Qwen2.5-7B on 1,000 DAPO-MATH-17K prompts and selects 1,000. In both paths, the warmed-up policy generates eight rollouts per prompt at temperature 1.0, and ground-truth matching supplies p.

GSM8K generation uses separate XML-style think and answer fields; DAPO requests a boxed final answer. The paper does not disclose the exact extraction/equivalence implementation. For every prompt, a GRPO gradient from the warmup checkpoint is randomly projected. The efficient DAPO configuration uses one correct rollout rather than every rollout; handling is not specified when a prompt has no correct rollout.

Downstream GRPO uses AdamW with learning rate 1e-6, beta values 0.9 and 0.999, epsilon 1e-8, KL coefficient 0.04, clip ratio 0.2, cosine warmup ratio 0.1, and two epochs. Batch size is 48 for GSM8K and 64 for DAPO-MATH-17K; maximum prompt length is 512, while maximum response length is 1,024 and 2,048 respectively. Evaluation uses greedy decoding on GSM8K and temperature 0.8/top-p 0.95 for the five-benchmark setting.

The nominal score matrix costs O(n^2 d) time and O(n^2) memory after projection. At the reported 10^3–10^4 scale, Step 4 is one batched matrix multiplication; the paper proposes Nyström and cascade approximations for larger pools but does not report those as LearnAlign experiments. Projection dimension, projection seed, training seeds, selected IDs, scores, rollouts, and gradients are not released.

GSM8K 路径先用随机 300 条 training prompts 对 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 做 warmup，再对 7,473 条 train pool 评分，并选择 100、500、1,000 或 2,000 条。DAPO 路径用 1,000 条 DAPO-MATH-17K prompts 对 Qwen2.5-3B 或 Qwen2.5-7B warmup，再选择 1,000 条。两条路径都让 warmup 后 policy 以 temperature 1.0 为每题生成 8 条 rollouts，并依据 ground-truth matching 计算 p。

GSM8K generation 使用分开的 XML-style think 与 answer fields；DAPO 要求 boxed final answer。论文没有披露精确的 extraction/equivalence 实现。每个 prompt 的 GRPO gradient 都从 warmup checkpoint 计算并随机投影。高效 DAPO 配置使用一条正确 rollout，而不是所有 rollouts；如果某题没有正确 rollout，论文没有说明如何处理。

下游 GRPO 使用 AdamW、learning rate 1e-6、beta 0.9/0.999、epsilon 1e-8、KL coefficient 0.04、clip ratio 0.2、cosine warmup ratio 0.1 和 2 epochs。GSM8K batch size 为 48，DAPO-MATH-17K 为 64；两者最大 prompt length 都是 512，最大 response length 分别为 1,024 和 2,048。评估时 GSM8K 采用 greedy decoding，五 benchmark 设置采用 temperature 0.8、top-p 0.95。

投影后的名义 score matrix 需要 O(n^2 d) 时间和 O(n^2) 内存。在论文报告的 10^3–10^4 规模，Step 4 是一次 batched matrix multiplication；论文为更大 pool 提出 Nyström 和 cascade approximation，但没有把它们作为 LearnAlign 实验运行。Projection dimension、projection seed、training seeds、selected IDs、scores、rollouts 和 gradients 均未发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On GSM8K, Table 1 reports 77.5% pass@1 with 1,000 selected prompts and 78.3% with 2,000, versus 77.0% after full-data training on 7,473 prompts. The same table reports 74.8% and 76.4% at 100 and 500 prompts. These are single paper-reported outcomes under one model/setup, not intrinsic-quality measurements of selected records.

For 1,000 prompts selected from DAPO-MATH-17K, Table 2 reports a five-benchmark average of 42.4 for Qwen2.5-3B versus 44.9 with full-data training, and 54.6 for Qwen2.5-7B versus 58.9 full. Thus the compact subset initially approaches but does not universally match full data. With longer training, Table 5 reports that the 3B subset reaches 83.8/67.8/36.9 on GSM8K/MATH500/AMC2023 at 2,000 steps, while its full baseline at 2,174 steps is 83.6/65.8/31.0; the analogous 7B comparison is mixed across metrics.

Component evidence is directionally supportive but limited. Removing warmup, learnability, or gradient similarity reduces several reported metrics; learnability-only and pass@8 filtering remain strong baselines, while LearnAlign is higher on the three Table 13 benchmarks. Adding K-means feature diversity does not consistently improve results. Three warmup subsets yield GSM8K 79.3–81.2, MATH500 60.2–61.8, and AMC2023 28.3–29.5, showing some checkpoint-path sensitivity rather than invariance.

The Qwen2.5-3B time audit reports 8h55m for selection—2h2m warmup, 2h41m rollouts, 4h12m gradient estimation, and 12.7 seconds matrix selection—plus 2.4 hours selected-subset training, compared with 42.3 hours full training. The hardware is described only as a single GPU. No official code, selected subsets, run logs, or gradients are available for independent reproduction or record-level inspection.

在 GSM8K 上，Table 1 报告选择 1,000 条 prompts 的 pass@1 为 77.5%，选择 2,000 条为 78.3%，而 7,473 条全量训练为 77.0%；100 与 500 条时分别为 74.8% 和 76.4%。这些是在一个模型/设置下由论文报告的单次结果，不是 selected records 内在质量的测量。

从 DAPO-MATH-17K 选择 1,000 条时，Table 2 报告 Qwen2.5-3B 的五 benchmark 平均分为 42.4，全量训练为 44.9；Qwen2.5-7B 分别为 54.6 和 58.9。因此小子集在初始设置中接近但并未普遍达到全量数据。延长训练后，Table 5 报告 3B 子集在 2,000 steps 时的 GSM8K/MATH500/AMC2023 为 83.8/67.8/36.9，而全量 baseline 在 2,174 steps 时为 83.6/65.8/31.0；对应的 7B 对照在不同指标上有得有失。

组件证据方向一致，但范围有限。移除 warmup、learnability 或 gradient similarity 会降低若干报告指标；learnability-only 和 pass@8 filtering 本身仍是强 baselines，而 LearnAlign 在 Table 13 的三个 benchmarks 上更高。加入 K-means feature diversity 没有稳定提升。三个 warmup subsets 得到 GSM8K 79.3–81.2、MATH500 60.2–61.8、AMC2023 28.3–29.5，说明 checkpoint path 存在一定敏感性，而非完全不变。

Qwen2.5-3B 的时间审计报告 selection 共 8h55m：warmup 2h2m、rollouts 2h41m、gradient estimation 4h12m、matrix selection 12.7 秒；之后 selected-subset training 为 2.4 小时，全量训练为 42.3 小时。硬件只写为 single GPU。由于没有官方代码、selected subsets、run logs 或 gradients，无法独立复现或做逐记录检查。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior selectors score instructions by perplexity, length, uncertainty, external models, SFT-oriented gradients, or full-training influence. Prior RLVR work such as LIMR and one-shot RLVR shows that small prompt sets can be effective but requires substantial training during selection. LearnAlign's specific change is to compute alignment under the GRPO objective and reintroduce a magnitude-like learning-potential term after cosine normalization through p(1-p).

The row-average pairwise score favors prompts that are simultaneously near the warmed-up policy's current capability boundary and directionally aligned with the wider pool. This makes consumer policy, verifier, and checkpoint part of the data-construction lineage rather than treating selected IDs as timeless data quality.

Gradient alignment, success-rate difficulty, random projection, top-N selection, and binary RLVR rewards are not individually new. LearnAlign is also not a new verifier, dataset release, process-supervision source, or fully online curriculum. Its useful direction signal for the atlas is the coupled recipe and the evidence that selection compute, scoring state, and rejected candidates are material parts of an RLVR data artifact.

既有 selectors 依据 perplexity、长度、不确定性、外部模型、SFT-oriented gradients 或全量训练 influence 为 instructions 评分。LIMR 与 one-shot RLVR 等先前工作说明小 prompt set 也可能有效，但 selection 期间需要大量训练。LearnAlign 的具体变化是按 GRPO objective 计算 alignment，并在 cosine normalization 后用 p(1-p) 补回类似 magnitude 的 learning-potential 信号。

两两分数的行平均偏向同时处在 warmup 后 policy 当前能力边界、又与较大 pool 方向一致的 prompts。这样一来，consumer policy、verifier 和 checkpoint 就成为 data-construction lineage 的组成部分，而 selected IDs 不再被视作永恒的数据质量。

Gradient alignment、success-rate difficulty、random projection、top-N selection 和 binary RLVR rewards 单独看都不是新概念。LearnAlign 也不是新的 verifier、dataset release、process-supervision source 或完整 online curriculum。对 atlas 而言，其方向价值来自组合 recipe，以及“selection compute、scoring state 与 rejected candidates 都是 RLVR data artifact 的实质部分”这一证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Checkpoint-relative score: rankings depend on the warmed-up policy, tokenizer, prompt template, pool, answer parser, projection, and random seeds. They can become stale after policy updates and are not shown to transfer across model families.
  • Coarse sparse feedback: eight binary rollouts restrict p to increments of one eighth. No adaptive rollout budget or per-prompt uncertainty interval is reported, and final-answer correctness does not validate intermediate reasoning.
  • Undisclosed verifier: the GSM8K and boxed-answer prompts are shown, but the exact extractor, normalization, and equivalence logic are not. Parser false accepts or rejects would affect p, gradients, ranking, and downstream results.
  • Gradient approximation: the efficient DAPO path takes one correct rollout per prompt, omitting failure-gradient information. The paper does not explain what is computed for a prompt with no correct rollout; random-projection dimension and seed are also unknown.
  • Missing release: no official implementation, selected or rejected IDs, scores, eight-rollout groups, correctness labels, projected gradients, warmup membership, checkpoint hash, or run manifest was confirmed. A statement that code will be released is not a current artifact.
  • Pool and split ambiguity: main text uses DAPO-MATH-17K, whereas Appendix F/H captions refer to DAPO-MATH-14K without explaining the effective pool or mapping. No decontamination or duplicate audit is reported.
  • Scale boundary: the explicit matrix is quadratic. The reported matrix step is fast for 10^3–10^4 prompts, but Nyström, cascade, LoRA-space gradients, and learned surrogates are proposed extensions rather than validated ultra-large-scale implementations.
  • Evidence scope: models are limited to Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B and selection pools are mathematical; CRUX is evaluation-only. Training-seed variance and hardware model are not reported, so timing and accuracy attribution remain bounded.
  • Rights and content audit: the ACL paper is CC BY 4.0, but upstream prompt, generated-rollout, subset, and future-code terms require separate checks. The Responsible NLP checklist reports no explicit identifying/offensive-content check, relying on the datasets' widespread use and an assertion that they contain no personal information.

• 依赖 checkpoint 的分数： 排序取决于 warmup 后 policy、tokenizer、prompt template、pool、answer parser、projection 和 random seeds。Policy 更新后分数可能过时，论文也未证明其可跨模型 family 迁移。
  • 粗粒度稀疏反馈： 8 条二元 rollouts 使 p 只能以 1/8 为步长变化。论文没有给出 adaptive rollout budget 或逐 prompt uncertainty interval，final-answer correctness 也不核验中间推理。
  • Verifier 未披露： 论文展示了 GSM8K 与 boxed-answer prompts，却没有给出精确 extractor、normalization 和 equivalence logic。Parser 的误接收或误拒绝会同时影响 p、gradients、ranking 和下游结果。
  • Gradient approximation： 高效 DAPO 路径每题只取一条正确 rollout，丢失 failure-gradient information。没有正确 rollout 时计算什么并未说明；random-projection dimension 与 seed 也为 unknown。
  • 发布缺失： 尚未确认官方 implementation、selected/rejected IDs、scores、8-rollout groups、correctness labels、projected gradients、warmup membership、checkpoint hash 或 run manifest。“将发布代码”的表述不等于当前 artifact。
  • Pool 与 split 歧义： 主文使用 DAPO-MATH-17K，但 Appendix F/H captions 写成 DAPO-MATH-14K，没有说明有效 pool 或 mapping。论文也未报告 decontamination 或 duplicate audit。
  • 规模边界： 显式矩阵为二次复杂度。论文在 10^3–10^4 prompts 上的 matrix step 很快，但 Nyström、cascade、LoRA-space gradients 和 learned surrogates 都是提议的扩展，不是已验证的超大规模实现。
  • 证据范围： 模型只覆盖 Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B，selection pools 以数学为主；CRUX 仅用于评估。论文没有报告 training-seed variance 或 GPU 型号，因此时间与准确率归因仍受限。
  • 权利与内容审计： ACL paper 是 CC BY 4.0，但上游 prompt、generated rollouts、subset 和未来 code 的条款需分别核对。Responsible NLP checklist 表明没有显式检查 identifying/offensive content，而是依据数据集被广泛使用及“不含个人信息”的作者断言。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release track, LearnAlign is useful as a recipe for policy-aware RLVR prompt selection when answers are programmatically checkable and the up-front scoring cost can be amortized. It clarifies that an auditable subset needs more than selected text: preserve upstream ID/revision, warmup membership, policy and tokenizer hashes, prompt template, all eight outputs, parsed answers, raw rewards, p, V, gradient/projection configuration, row score, rank, keep/reject flag, and downstream run assignment.

Reuse class: reference and reconstruction recipe; blocked pending artifacts for faithful reproduction. A researcher can implement a controlled approximation from the equations and settings, but cannot reproduce the published subset or validate selection decisions without code, checker, projection, seeds, and row-level records. Existing GSM8K or DAPO releases should not be described as LearnAlign-selected data.

Useful controlled comparisons include random selection, learnability-only, pass@8 filtering, cheaper embedding or feature similarity, full-rollout versus one-correct-rollout gradients, and static versus periodic rescoring. Report selection and training compute separately, including rollout tokens and gradient cost; subset benchmark accuracy alone cannot attribute gains to prompt quality.

A dynamic or staged policy should recompute scores and retain every selection snapshot. Publishing both accepted and rejected candidates would expose how the curriculum changes, allow parser and score audits, and connect subset construction to the exact policy that consumed it.

对 Data Construction and Open Release track，LearnAlign 适合作为 policy-aware RLVR prompt selection recipe：答案需可程序核验，且前期评分成本能够由后续 RLVR 摊销。它说明可审计 subset 不能只有 selected text，还应保留 upstream ID/revision、warmup membership、policy/tokenizer hashes、prompt template、全部 8 条输出、parsed answers、raw rewards、p、V、gradient/projection 配置、row score、rank、keep/reject flag 与 downstream run assignment。

复用等级：可作参考与重建 recipe；忠实复现仍被 artifact 缺失阻挡。研究者可依据公式和设置实现受控近似，但没有代码、checker、projection、seeds 与逐行 records，就无法复现论文 subset 或验证 selection decisions。现有 GSM8K 或 DAPO release 不能被描述为 LearnAlign-selected data。

适合的受控对照包括 random selection、learnability-only、pass@8 filtering、更便宜的 embedding/feature similarity、full-rollout 与 one-correct-rollout gradients，以及 static 与 periodic rescoring。应分别报告 selection 和 training compute，包括 rollout tokens 与 gradient cost；subset benchmark accuracy 不能单独归因于 prompt quality。

动态或分阶段 policy 应重新计算 scores，并保留每次 selection snapshot。同时发布 accepted 与 rejected candidates，才能观察 curriculum 如何变化、审计 parser 与分数，并把 subset construction 连接到实际消费它的精确 policy。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Use Findings of ACL 2026 as the official venue/year; the 2025 entry ID reflects the first arXiv submission.
  • Read Sections 4.3–4.4 together: eight-rollout p(1-p), projected GRPO gradients, the n-by-n matrix, row means, and top-N selection define one policy-relative data object.
  • Compare Tables 1, 2, 5, and 13 before claiming full-data parity; results depend on subset size, model, metric, and training-step budget.
  • Include all 8h55m of selection in efficiency accounting; gradient estimation, not the 12.7-second matrix multiplication, is the largest reported component.
  • Preserve as unresolved the answer checker, projection dimension/seed, selected and rejected rows, DAPO 17K/14K naming, training seeds, decontamination, and license lineage.
  • Treat proposed Nyström/cascade scaling and future code release as unverified future work, not available artifacts.

• 以 Findings of ACL 2026 作为正式 venue/year；entry ID 中的 2025 对应 arXiv 首次提交。
  • 连读 Sections 4.3–4.4：8-rollout p(1-p)、投影 GRPO gradients、n×n matrix、row means 与 top-N selection 共同定义一个依赖 policy 的数据对象。
  • 在声称达到全量数据表现前，对照 Tables 1、2、5 和 13；结果会随 subset size、model、metric 与 training-step budget 改变。
  • 效率核算必须包含全部 8h55m selection；最大报告成本是 gradient estimation，而不是 12.7 秒的 matrix multiplication。
  • 保持 unresolved：answer checker、projection dimension/seed、selected/rejected rows、DAPO 17K/14K 命名、training seeds、decontamination 与 license lineage。
  • 将 Nyström/cascade scaling 与未来代码发布视为未验证的 future work，而不是可用 artifact。

value.html: GSM8K train contributes 7,473 question-answer pairs; DAPO-MATH-17K supplies the larger mathematical prompt pool. LearnAlign selects policy-specific prompt subsets and does not publish a new reasoning-trace dataset.
GSM8K prompts request separate <think> and <answer> fields. DAPO-MATH-17K prompts request step-by-step reasoning with the final answer in a boxed form.
The exact target Qwen2.5 policy after random-subset GRPO warmup generates eight exploration rollouts per prompt. The efficient DAPO setting estimates each prompt gradient from one correct rollout.
Offline scoring at one warmed-up policy checkpoint, followed by GRPO/RLVR training on the selected prompt subset.

A rule-based binary final-answer judgment supplies rollout success. The paper does not specify the exact extractor or equivalence implementation. Learnability V=p(1-p) weights cosine alignment between projected per-prompt GRPO gradients; this is a selection score, not a process verifier.
Average each prompt's pairwise LearnAlign scores over all n candidates, including itself, sort row means in descending order, and retain the top N prompts for subsequent RLVR.
Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct for GSM8K; Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B for DAPO-MATH-17K.
none reported; ground-truth final answers and the warmed-up target policy provide correctness feedback and rollouts.
The target Qwen2.5 policy after GRPO warmup on a random subset generates the eight rollouts used for learnability estimation.

Random warmup subset to GRPO warmup to eight rollouts per prompt at temperature 1.0 to binary success and p(1-p) to projected GRPO gradient to pairwise score matrix to row mean to top-N subset to downstream GRPO.
1.0 for selection rollouts and training generation; evaluation uses 0 for GSM8K and 0.8 with top-p 0.95 for the five-benchmark DAPO setting.
Normalize each per-prompt GRPO gradient, multiply by p(1-p), apply a random projection, compute the n-by-n cosine-alignment matrix, average each row, and select the highest-scoring N prompts.

Warmup uses 300 GSM8K or 1,000 DAPO-MATH-17K prompts. GSM8K selection sizes are 100, 500, 1,000, and 2,000; DAPO selection uses 1,000 prompts. The nominal score computation costs O(n^2 d) time and O(n^2) space; random-projection dimension, projection seed, and training seeds are unknown.

GRPO with AdamW, learning rate 1e-6, beta1 0.9, beta2 0.999, epsilon 1e-8, KL coefficient 0.04, clip ratio 0.2, cosine warmup ratio 0.1, and two epochs. Batch size is 48 for GSM8K and 64 for DAPO-MATH-17K; maximum response lengths are 1,024 and 2,048 respectively.
Public GSM8K or DAPO-MATH-17K prompt-answer pairs, a random warmup subset, target-policy rollouts, binary final-answer labels, and projected GRPO gradients.

Selection uses training pools. Evaluation uses GSM8K and MATH500 pass@1, AMC2023 avg@8, AIME2024 pass@8, and CRUX pass@1. Appendix captions unexpectedly call some DAPO experiments DAPO-MATH-14K rather than DAPO-MATH-17K, with no mapping or explanation.

items: Scores are policy-, checkpoint-, tokenizer-, prompt-template-, warmup-, pool-, parser-, projection-, and seed-specific and become stale as the policy changes.
Eight rollouts discretize success rate in increments of one eighth; no confidence interval or adaptive rollout rule is supplied per prompt.
Binary final-answer feedback does not validate intermediate reasoning, and the exact answer extractor and equivalence checker are undisclosed.
The efficient one-correct-rollout gradient drops failure-gradient information and leaves handling of prompts with no correct rollout unspecified.
Random-projection dimension, random seed, selected prompt IDs, scores, rollouts, gradients, rejected records, and downstream run bindings are not released.
The n-by-n matrix is quadratic before proposed Nyström or cascade approximations; those ultra-large-scale paths are suggestions rather than reported LearnAlign runs.
Main text uses DAPO-MATH-17K while Appendix F/H captions use DAPO-MATH-14K, so the effective candidate-pool manifest is unresolved.
Results are limited to Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B and primarily mathematical selection pools; CRUX is evaluation-only.
Training-seed variance is not reported. Three warmup subsets produce visible but bounded metric differences, and no complete immutable run manifest is available.

The Responsible NLP checklist says no explicit identifying/offensive-content check was conducted, relying instead on the assertion that the datasets are widely used and contain no personal information.
